## Où j'en suis
`cmd/replay` is implemented in ingest: dry-run mode, `--from/--to` window, dedup check, per-partition ordering (workers split by partition key), and a hard-coded topic allowlist limited to `events.replay.v3`. Real-archive dry run on 2026-11-12 14:10–17:40 UTC read 412 objects / 18,445,225 lines: 18,442,107 events would be replayed, 0 already in the dedup store, 3,118 malformed (schema v2) lines written to the rejects file. PR #233 is open, ready for review, with Daniel Levi as reviewer. The real replay and the aggregator backfill have not been run yet.

- [en-cours] PR #233 open awaiting Daniel's review; real replay into `events.replay.v3` not started
- [prochaine-étape] run the real replay into `events.replay.v3`, then the aggregator `--backfill` for 2026-11-12
- [prochaine-étape] give Rachel the ETA for Fernhill and Orbitly once Daniel has reviewed
- [essai-raté] dry-run job at `--batch 50000` was OOMKilled (exit 137, 2Gi limit, ~2.6Gi peak) → re-run with `--batch 5000`: 19m42s, 310 MiB peak
- [décision] replay everything, no 72h age cutoff; target only `events.replay.v3`, never `events.v3` (source: t05)
